# Third-party visual effects

Downloaded on 2026-09-17 (Asia/Seoul). Original PNGs are unchanged. These files contain visual art only; no third-party damage scripts or colliders are used.

| Folder | Author and asset | Source file | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MetaShinryu | [Slash Effect Collection](https://opengameart.org/content/slash-effect-collection) | Slash Effect Collection.zip: Big/Circular.png, Big/Arcing.png, Huge/Lunge Thrust.png | CC0 1.0 |
| Umplix | [Fireball Spritesheet](https://opengameart.org/content/fireball-spritesheet) | fireball_10.png (download page label: fireball.png) | CC0 1.0 |
| BenHickling | [Explosion](https://opengameart.org/content/explosion-7) | explosion1_6.png (download page label: explosion1.png) | CC0 1.0 |

Each linked creator page declares CC0. [CC0 1.0 dedication and legal code](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) applies. Credits are retained here even where not required. No purchase was made. Imported sprite regions, playback and in-game scale are configured separately in the project. Local acquisition hashes and image dimensions are recorded under Logs/Validation/bcd-baseline/unit-vfx-originals.json; integration status is in docs/planning/ASSET_SOURCES.md.
